title: Oceanography CTDCruiseStations

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed oceanographic CTD analysis research task. Generated synthetic CTD profiles for 6 stations, analyzed vertical thermohaline structure, identified water masses (Surface Water, Subtropical Underwater, Antarctic Intermediate Water, Thermocline Water, Deep Water), examined spatial variability, and produced comprehensive report with 7 figures. All deliverables created: code in code/, outputs in outputs/, and final report in report/report.md.
